headline: Mexican Peso Drops 3.5% Over Week to MXN 19.19 per Dollar
summary: The Mexican peso depreciated 0.5% on Friday to trade at MXN 19.19 per US dollar, capping a weekly loss of 3.5% to reach its lowest level since June 2025.
why: The Mexican peso is one of the most liquid emerging-market currencies and an indicator of Latin American market sentiment.

impacts.name: Mexican Peso
impacts.why: The peso fell 0.5% on the day to 19.19 per dollar, marking a 3.5% weekly depreciation.
